doc: The M3 adoption of extracted documents (BUILD_PLAN §2 invariant 3; docs/HUMAN_ANSWERS.md, delegated Q19: extracted facts are the input of every M3 law, and a waiver never applies where an extracted document exists). Fixed at the I24 prereg. The three documents are the extracted counterparts of the three hand-written documents M0-M2 derived from: spec/M2/facts/morph_header.extracted.json (I17: the Solidity side of facts/morph_header.json), spec/M2/facts/morph_batch.go.extracted.json (I18: the Go side of facts/morph_header.json and the batch data of spec/M1/facts/morph_batchdata.json) and spec/M2/facts/morph_rollup.extracted.json (I19/A19: spec/M1/facts/morph_rollup.json). The other Go documents (blob, derivation, genesis, nodetypes) replace no hand document and wait for the iterations that cover their components (I36-I39). No hand-written fact document is an M3 input, and no waiver is requested. reextraction is empty and width false: rule SORT is not in M3's catalog until I30 (Sorts III), so nothing here re-derives an M2 law. holon.diagram.evidence reads this file as I20 made it read M2's (an adopted transitions document is covered with anchors only); the linked codec layer of I24 (rules X0-X9 of tests_m3/test_derive_par.py) reads the codec documents it lists together with the link roles of spec/M3/lib/link.json.
